title: Martin Luther
summary: Martin Luther (1483–1546), an Augustinian monk, priest and professor at Wittenberg, attacked the Church’s teaching on indulgences in his Ninety-Five Theses of 31 October 1517, the start of the Protestant Reformation. He taught salvation through faith alone and the authority of scripture, was excommunicated in 1521 and defied the emperor at the Diet of Worms, and published a complete German Bible in 1534. His thought still marks Protestant churches.
